# QShala — India's Quriosity Company (LLMs & AI Search Documentation)

> QShala replaces rote learning with curiosity, Socratic storytelling, and inquiry. We partner with 250+ K-12 partner schools, 80+ top corporate organizations, leading universities, and thousands of families across India.

## 2. Core Value Proposition & Pedagogy (WHY & HOW)
- **The Core Problem**: Traditional Indian education and standard quiz competitions reward rote memorization of static facts without teaching children *why* things work.
- **The Socratic Method**: QShala facilitates guided inquiry. Instead of lecturing factual answers, facilitators ask scaffolded questions that lead learners to deduce scientific, historical, or economic concepts through first principles.
- **Proprietary Technology**: Digital buzzers, real-time leaderboards, interactive daily quiz engines, and gamified quest decks.

---

## 3. Services & Program Directory (WHAT & WHO FOR)

### A. K-12 Schools & Timetabled Curriculum
- **Program Link**: [QShala for Schools](https://qshala.com/schools)
- **Audience**: Principals, Academic Coordinators, Trustees, and Students (Grades 1 to 12).
- **Delivery Format**: 40 to 60-minute weekly timetabled modules replacing or complementing General Knowledge / Life Skills periods.
- **4 Year-Long Programs**:
  1. *Weekly Quriosity Clubs* (Socratic Inquiry & Thinking Sport)
  2. *Financial Literacy for Kids* (Budgeting, compounding, economic thinking)
  3. *Public Speaking & Socratic Debate* (Confidence, articulation, logic)
  4. *GK & Current Affairs Storytelling* (Global context, media literacy)
- **Championships**: Inter-school buzzer championships with stage setups and live quizmasters.

### B. Corporates & Hybrid Teams
- **Program Link**: [QShala for Corporates](https://qshala.com/companies)
- **Audience**: HR Heads, Chief People Officers, L&D Directors, Culture Leads.
- **Clients**: Google, Flipkart, Wipro, TCS, Infosys, Amazon, Microsoft, HDFC Bank, Netflix, Apple.
- **Formats**: High-octane Friday trivia nights, gamified new hire onboarding, leadership offsites, and company milestone trivia.
- **Measured Outcomes**: 90%+ employee engagement scores and 10% average reduction in workplace attrition through psychological safety.

### C. Colleges & Campus Fests
- **Program Link**: [QShala for Colleges](https://qshala.com/colleges)
- **Audience**: College Fest Committees, Student Councils, Academic Departments.
- **Formats**: Law moot trivia, Finance leagues, STEM hackathon quizzes, and packed auditorium festival championships.

### D. Communities & Families
- **Program Link**: [QShala for Communities](https://qshala.com/communities)
- **Audience**: Housing societies, apartment complexes, alumni reunions, family gatherings.
- **Formats**: Screen-free weekend family game nights, inter-apartment quiz leagues, milestone birthday trivia.

### E. Custom Experiences & Bespoke Quests
- **Program Link**: [Custom Experiences](https://qshala.com/custom)
- **Formats**: Museum scavenger trails, brand activation challenges, podcast trivia experiences.
